notes: aw_held/w_held/b_pending are helper registers reset by !i_rst_n. The assertions sample them before the edge, so they show the state of the cycle that ends at the edge. "n >= R1+1" is modelled with $past(i_rst_n) in the antecedent. aw_mapped_q is latched at the AW transfer (when no address is held), using the word index awaddr[PARA_ADDR_W-1:2], so the bit width follows PARA_ADDR_W. I have not compiled this or run it in Verilator.
